story: DF1.9 - Lean Worker Profile: Measure the Extension/Skill Overhead
headline: THE DELIVERABLE IS THE MEASUREMENT APPARATUS, AND IT IS REAL. THE 5-6x PAYOFF IS STILL UNMEASURED ON THIS HOST: no funded OpenRouter key exists, so no arm has ever run against a real provider. Nothing below is a measurement of pi's actual overhead reduction.

run1_preflightRefusal.purpose: the real, unmodified command on this host
stdout: lean-bench: preflight failed — OPENROUTER_API_KEY is unset; the benchmark roster is OpenRouter-only and refuses to run rather than produce a one-armed comparison. Nothing was spent.
run1_preflightRefusal.reading: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is unset, so the bench refused BEFORE any spend and wrote no artifact at all. A preflight failure is not a measurement, and writing one would invite it being read as a result. This is INV-5 and the AC4 fail-closed path working on the real host, not a simulation.
run1_preflightRefusal.piVersionSeen: 0.55.0 - the workspace-pinned @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent that `bun run` puts on PATH via node_modules/.bin, i.e. the F13 pin. A bare shell `pi` resolves instead to the global @earendil-works build (0.84.1); the project's own scripts never use it.

run2_harnessIntegrity.purpose: exercise the whole apparatus end to end - two arms, manifest rewrite, raw capture, first-turn parsing, aggregation, verdict - without a provider
run2_harnessIntegrity.stubbedLever: The stub pi reports first-turn input = 8000 task tokens + 37279 discovery overhead, and drops the overhead when it sees --no-extensions AND --no-skills. The 37279 figure is the MEASURED overhead from gates report sec3.3; that the flags remove it is the ASSUMPTION UNDER TEST, and this stub assumes it. The resulting ratio therefore measures the harness, NOT pi.

notes: Arms are INTERLEAVED, actual order: control#1, lean#1, control#2, lean#2, control#3, lean#3 — neither arm inherits the other's warm prompt cache.
n counts iterations that produced at least one observation, not iterations attempted.

ratio = control mean first-turn input tokens / lean mean, per worker then averaged; deltaTokens is the absolute tokens removed. A large task prompt inflates BOTH arms' first-turn totals and can push the ratio under 5 while the lever worked exactly as claimed — read deltaTokens beside the verdict, not the ratio alone.

run2_harnessIntegrity.reading: ratio 5.659875, deltaTokens 74558, verdict supported - which is exactly what the stub was built to produce. It proves the arms, the capture, the parser and the aggregation are wired correctly. It proves nothing about pi.

reviewHardening.note: Round 1 of the pre-PR review found two FAIL-OPEN holes in the harness and two security holes in the capture path. All four are fixed and regression-locked; they are recorded here because each one would have produced a confidently wrong number or a real exposure.
reviewHardening.failOpen1_controlArmWorkerVanishes: The agent set was derived from the CONTROL arm's observed runs, so a worker that failed to spawn in the control arm was DELETED from the report rather than failing it: the run returned `supported` with a ratio computed from the survivors and an empty errors list. The expected set now comes from the manifest and missing-ness is checked for BOTH arms.
reviewHardening.failOpen2_nCountedAttemptsNotObservation: `n` was the iteration count, set unconditionally, so the >=3 guard could never trip on real data — an arm could report n=3 while a worker contributed one observation, and that single run was averaged as a three-run mean. TWO fixes: the >=3 requirement is now enforced per worker per arm on the observations actually collected, AND `n` itself now counts iterations that produced at least one observation rather than iterations attempted, so the number the artifact reports is the number a reader thinks it is.
reviewHardening.security1_captureModeAndSymlink: writeFileSync applies `mode` only at CREATION and follows symlinks, so a pre-existing 0644 file kept its mode and a pre-existing symlink redirected the worker's compiled prompt into the link target — arbitrary-file overwrite via an operator-supplied capture dir. Now: lstat + unlink, then openSync(path, 'wx', 0o600), and the directory is created 0700.
reviewHardening.security2_symlinkExtensionEscape: resolveExtensionPaths was purely lexical, so `<root>/ext/out -> /etc` passed containment and `-e ext/out` was handed to pi. Containment is now checked on the realpath'd form only — a lexical-AND-realpath combination was tried and reverted in Round 2 because it rejected legitimate paths on macOS, where /tmp and /var are themselves symlinks. Empty/whitespace and non-string entries are rejected too — the latter previously threw inside the promise executor and killed the WHOLE team run instead of degrading one worker.
alsoFixed: Truncated captures (the 8 MiB cap) now mark the run inconclusive instead of yielding a first-turn number from a stream that may have lost the turn (INV-5).
Arms are INTERLEAVED (C,L,C,L,...) rather than run back to back, so the second arm does not inherit the first's warm prompt cache — the 'warm-cache parity' the Infra Prerequisites row asks for.
Model slugs are recorded per run from the manifest (AC1) instead of the placeholder '(from manifest)'.
The per-run log line now carries the full Observability Contract field set.
QDS_BENCH_RUNS is parsed with the same bounded-integer discipline as PI_COMS_TIMEOUT_MS; a non-numeric value previously produced NaN iterations that also defeated the underpowered guard.
8 MiB truncation trims back to a whole codepoint instead of leaving a U+FFFD.

bugFoundByTheE2EDemo.symptom: The first end-to-end bench run reported ratio 4.11 -> 'refuted' even though the modelled lever removed exactly 37,279 tokens from every worker.
bugFoundByTheE2EDemo.cause: The driver's raw capture writes a stream for the LEAD as well as the workers, and the harness averaged the lead in. `lean` is a per-worker flag and the lead is never leaned, so its ratio is 1.0 by construction: per-worker ratios of 5.66, 5.66 and 1.0 average to 4.11.
bugFoundByTheE2EDemo.impact: A silent drag toward 'refuted' on every run - the harness would have under-reported the lever it exists to measure, on the exact hypothesis the story is about.
bugFoundByTheE2EDemo.fix: workerAgentIds() reads team.workers[].agentId from the manifest and the harness measures only those agents. After the fix the same stub yields ratio 5.66 -> 'supported'.
bugFoundByTheE2EDemo.regressionLocked: tests/lean-worker-benchmark.test.ts - 'workerAgentIds - the lead is never measured'.

whyDeltaTokensSitsBesideTheRatio.spec: Technical Notes: 'refuted alongside deltaTokens ~= 37K is an artifact of prompt size, not a refutation - the verdict file must let a reader see that.'
whyDeltaTokensSitsBesideTheRatio.demonstrated: The pre-fix run is exactly that failure mode in miniature: deltaTokens was a clean 74,558 (2 x 37,279, the full modelled overhead on both workers) while the ratio read 4.11 and the verdict read 'refuted'. A reader with only the ratio would have concluded the lever failed. A reader with deltaTokens beside it sees the lever worked perfectly and the ratio was diluted. The artifact carries both, per worker and in aggregate.

argvProof.purpose: AC2/AC3 - what the driver actually execs, captured from a pi stub that echoes its own argv
argvProof.reading: The default worker's argv is the exact 9-element argv that shipped before this story - lean is opt-in and the default path did not move (AC3). Under lean, --no-extensions --no-skills and both explicit -e pairs land BEFORE -p, which stays last and still carries prompt + schema instruction (AC2). Explicit -e paths survive --no-extensions because it disables discovery only.

securityProof.extensionEscapeRefused: A worker declaring extensions: ['../../../etc'] was refused BEFORE spawn: 'worker worker-escape refused: extensions path escapes the repo root: ../../../etc'. The path is echoed for the operator and never executed; the worker fails closed rather than silently running without its declared extensions (INV-2, INV-3).
securityProof.rawCaptureOptIn: With QDS_TEAM_RAW_WORKER_DIR unset, no file and no directory is created anywhere (AC5). With it set, each worker's stream is written as <agentId>.ndjson at mode 0600 - verified -rw------- on disk, including the pre-existing-file and planted-symlink cases - via an exclusive openSync(path,'wx',0o600), NOT writeArtifactAtomic (which JSON.stringifys, forces .json and sets no mode). LIMIT, stated: the directory is created 0700 when the driver creates it, but mkdirSync does NOT change the mode of a directory that already exists, so an operator pointing QDS_TEAM_RAW_WORKER_DIR at an existing 0755 directory gets 0755. Files stay 0600 either way, so the residual exposure is the listing of agent ids, not content.
securityProof.redactionScope: Every byte passes redactSecrets seeded from the parent env, so OPENROUTER_API_KEY-shaped values are masked. LIMIT, stated: redaction covers parent-env values under secret-ish key names only (DF1.5 INV-1). Secrets embedded in the compiled prompt, in manifest values, or in files the worker read are NOT parent-env values and are NOT masked. The supported boundary is parent-env coverage + 0600 + the opt-in directory; captured NDJSON is client source code and stays inside the repo data boundary.
securityProof.capture: Bounded at 8 MiB with the truncation recorded in-file; agentId must be a single safe path component or nothing is written.

deviations.piVersionGate: The spec's preflight asserts `pi --version` starts 0.55. — implemented as specified. Under `npm run`/`bun run` the workspace-pinned pi IS 0.55.0, so the gate passes on this host by the intended route. QDS_BENCH_ALLOW_PI_VERSION=1 is an explicit, recorded escape hatch for measuring against another build; when used, the actual version is written into the artifact's notes rather than swallowed.
deviations.manifestEditNotNeeded: Files to Modify lists cli-anything/src/manifest.ts. It needed no change: it delegates wholly to TeamManifestSchema, so widening TeamRoleSchema in types.ts IS the load path. Editing it would have been a no-op diff.
deviations.extensionsCheckedOnlyUnderLean: The DoD clause 'an extensions path outside the repo root is rejected before spawn' is unconditional; the implementation validates only when lean is set, because buildWorkerArgv emits -e nowhere else. Killing a worker over a field that was never going to reach pi's argv is a denial of service, not a protection. A non-lean worker carrying extensions is logged ('extensions ignored (lean is not set)') instead.
deviations.containmentIsCwdNotGitRoot: Round 3 fix: resolveExtensionPaths is now called with REPO_ROOT (`pathResolve(import.meta.dir, '..', '..')`), not process.cwd(), so containment is against the repository root regardless of the subdirectory the harness is invoked from. This deviation no longer applies.
deviations.armSelection: The two arms are produced by rewriting the manifest (yaml, already a dependency) rather than by adding a driver-side env override, so the only difference between arms is the manifest key this story actually ships - no second configuration path that production never uses.

whatRemainsUnmeasured: The hypothesis itself. A real verdict needs a funded OPENROUTER_API_KEY and one `npm run bench:lean-worker`; the apparatus is complete and will record supported, refuted or inconclusive with equal willingness. No AC or artifact field in this story asserts a saving the harness did not compute.
